name: wordwhirl
description: WORDWHIRL — a portrait swipe-word adventure for RUN.world, built with PixiJS 8 and a WebGPU-first renderer.

scripts.test: node scripts/test-noise-random.mjs && node scripts/check-player-number-formatting.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/simulate-wordwhirl.ts && node scripts/check-game.mjs
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/check-build.mjs embedded
scripts.build:bundled: npm run typecheck && cross-env RUNDOT_GAME_DISABLE_EMBEDDED_LIBS=true vite build && node scripts/check-build.mjs bundled
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run audit:public && npm run build && npm run build:bundled
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run visual-qa
